handoffs.message: Ready for review: PR #284 adds the Part B5 first-week observation report builder, operations runbook, and focused tests. Verified: pytest -q tests/broker; python3 -m py_compile services/broker/live_activation/first_week_observation.py tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py.

Review reopened: _check_observation_window currently accepts invalid ISO-8601 live_started_at/observed_through_at when explicit observation_window_days/window_days is >= 7. Repro: set live_started_at='not-a-time', observed_through_at='also-not-a-time', observation_window_days=7; build_first_week_observation_report returns can_continue_live=True and continue_live. Required: fail closed on invalid timestamps even when explicit days are present, and add a regression test. Reviewer verification: pytest -q tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py passed; py_compile passed.

All three artifacts ready for review: 13-check first-week observation builder (first_week_observation.py), runbook doc (first_week_observation_window.md), and test suite (test_first_week_observation.py, 7 tests). pytest -q: 7 passed. Commits: 2363bb3d anchor, 24c8ebd4 fail-closed timestamps, 5a6f9308 task brief update.

Review changes requested: first_week_observation.py accepts reversed observation timestamps when observation_window_days=7 is supplied; repro sets live_started_at=2026-05-26T00:00:00Z, observed_through_at=2026-05-19T00:00:00Z, observation_window_days=7 and currently returns can_continue_live=True/continue_live. Please fail closed with chronological blocker and add a regression test. Verified current suite: pytest -q tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py (7 passed); py_compile pass; supplemental repro exposes failure.

Review changes requested: (1) first_week_observation.py allows reversed timestamps to pass when observation_window_days=7 is supplied; repro live_started_at=2026-05-26T00:00:00Z, observed_through_at=2026-05-19T00:00:00Z, observation_window_days=7 returns can_continue_live=True/continue_live. Add chronological fail-closed blocker and regression test. (2) report_id ignores nested observation_window.observed_through_at; changing 2026-05-26 to 2026-05-27 leaves report_id unchanged. Derive report identity from context-resolved window fields. Verified current suite: pytest -q tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py (7 passed); py_compile pass; supplemental repros expose failures.

Both issues resolved. (1) _observation_timestamp_blockers now parses timestamps once and blocks when end < start, even when observation_window_days is explicitly provided. (2) _report_id accepts _ObservationContext and uses _first_string(context, ...) for observed_through_at, capturing nested observation_window fields. Two regression tests added. pytest -q → 9 passed; py_compile → OK. Commit d70efd1c on task/BLA-007-V2.

Review approved: focused tests passed (pytest -q tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py; python3 -m py_compile services/broker/live_activation/first_week_observation.py tests/broker/test_first_week_observation.py). Fixes verified for reversed timestamp fail-closed handling and nested observation_window observed_through_at report_id stability; return to Claude for closeout.
